Tomorrow is Apple's biggest annual product launch event, and new Apple Watch models are expected to be unveiled. In a rare move this time, all configurations of the Apple Watch SE 3 are completely unavailable for purchase on the Apple website.

The Apple website shows that all Apple Watch SE 3 models are "currently out of stock"

Apple is expected to launch new iPhone and Apple Watch models at its event on September 9, along with quite possibly more products including AirPods.

However, before the event takes place, one of the current Apple Watch models — the Apple Watch SE 3 — is already unavailable for purchase on the Apple website.

According to MacRumors, no matter how you configure any version of the Apple Watch SE 3, the Apple website will ultimately show the model as "currently out of stock". The situation is the same whether you choose the delivery option or pick up in store at an Apple retail location.

Apple generally does not preemptively take products off the shelves before new products launch.

But what makes this move particularly intriguing is that there have been no rumours whatsoever about an Apple Watch SE 4 launching tomorrow.

Instead, we only expect the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 to be the newly launched models.

Perhaps the current stock shortage is just a system bug that will be resolved shortly. But at this stage, it seems to hint that a new generation of Apple Watch SE may debut tomorrow.

We will continue to follow up on any updates regarding the availability of the Apple Watch SE 3.
